baseline_models.mechanism: The collective noun gathers a substantial body, while الأولين locates its members at the beginning or ahead in temporal order.

activation_trace.role: A gathered human multitude supplies the cohort and its substantial scale.
Beginning and precedence place the cohort among people earlier in time or order.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified number of old people.
changed_reading.after: A coherent, substantial cohort drawn from people prior in time or order.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The combination of ثُلَّةٌ with the split mapping of أَوَّلِينَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The non-dominant mapped root keeps uninterrupted succession active beside temporal firstness, so the group can be heard as the leading band within an ordered human sequence.

activation_trace.role: The assembled multitude provides a bounded leading band.
Unbroken succession turns 'earlier' into a relative position inside a continuing sequence.

changed_reading.before: A crowd isolated somewhere in the past.
changed_reading.after: The gathered leading segment of a succession that can continue beyond it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated designation of companionship and right/blessing supplies a social and evaluative container for the cohort, changing ثلة from a free-standing crowd into an affiliated contingent.

activation_trace.role: The gathered multitude is the entity whose constituency is being specified.
Repeated companionship supplies durable affiliation as the group's social bond.
Blessing gives the affiliation its positive evaluative direction.
The immediately repeated companions label reopens the constituency just before the count.
Right as strength and right-standing sharpens the cohort's status without making firstness its merit.

structural_cues: 56:27 introduces the companions of the right, and 56:38 repeats that designation immediately before 56:39.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated designation and the collective noun; I treat recurrence plus adjacency as a constituency arrow. A live alternative is that 56:39 begins an independent demographic statement.

changed_reading.before: A large but socially undefined earlier crowd.
changed_reading.after: A substantial earlier contingent within the companions of the right, held together by affiliation and right-standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ordered joining, connected extension, numeric increase, and the negation of ending or obstruction form a sustained-abundance regime around the group, making ثلة feel like durable plenty rather than a one-time census.

activation_trace.role: The substantial gathered group is the focus quantity reframed by the surrounding material regime.
Joining things in ordered coordination supplies organization rather than an accidental mass.
Connected increase supplies replenishing continuity to the abundance frame.
Growth in number reinforces the substantial quantity already latent in ثلة.
Negated ending blocks depletion within the surrounding abundance pattern.
Negated obstruction makes access, rather than exclusion, the environmental norm.

structural_cues: 56:29-33 presents a cumulative nominal sequence whose abundance is ordered, extended, increased, and explicitly neither cut off nor barred.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated material pattern; I analogically transfer its regime, not its predicates, to the perception of ثلة. The live alternative confines every quality to provisions and leaves the group as a bare headcount.

changed_reading.after: A substantial cohort perceived within an ordered, replenishing, and unobstructed economy of plenty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence of new creation, transformation, and first-state imagery makes الأولين resonate not only as an earlier population but also as beginning restored as a present condition.

activation_trace.role: Beginning and precedence provide the focus term whose temporal force is being reopened.
Deliberate new creation supplies the process capable of restoring a beginning-state.
Transformation into a condition supplies the arrow from origin to renewed state.
Firstness and first-fruit imagery makes renewed beginning visible inside that transformed state.

structural_cues: 56:35-36 is an explicit creation-to-making sequence immediately before the beneficiary label in 56:38 and the cohort statement in 56:39.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies transformation followed by a lexical image of firstness; I let that sequence color الأولين as restored origin. The materially live alternative is the grammatically stronger reading of a purely chronological partitive.

changed_reading.before: People classified only by having lived earlier.
changed_reading.after: An earlier-derived cohort whose beginning can also be heard as renewed and made present.

context_deltas.mechanism: Equal age and companionship neutralize present seniority, so الأولين more sharply marks provenance or sequence-position rather than the cohort's current age.

activation_trace.role: Temporal beginning supplies the source distinction that must be separated from present age.
Equality in age and companionship removes current seniority as the function of 'earlier'.

structural_cues: The equal-age description at 56:37 directly precedes the beneficiary label and the earlier-cohort statement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies equal age beside an earlier descriptor; I infer that equality blocks a current-age hierarchy. A live alternative restricts أترابا to the immediately described companions without letting it govern the cohort label.

changed_reading.before: The earlier ones are presently the older group.
changed_reading.after: The cohort comes from an earlier source-position without being defined by present seniority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah repeats the same collective noun and changes only the temporal pole, turning 56:39 into the first half of an earlier/later provenance pair rather than an exclusive claim for the earlier group.

activation_trace.role: The first substantial gathered cohort establishes one side of the parallel.
Earlier position labels the first cohort by temporal provenance.
The repeated substantial multitude gives the later side the same cohort category.
Later position supplies the opposed provenance pole without changing the collective noun.

structural_cues: 56:40 coordinates an otherwise matching phrase with و and substitutes later ones for earlier ones.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact lexical and syntactic parallelism; I infer comparable cohort status and scale, not exact numerical equality. A live alternative treats the symmetry as categorical only.

changed_reading.before: The earlier cohort is the whole group or possesses firstness as exclusive superiority.
changed_reading.after: It is one substantial provenance cohort in a two-sided assembly, matched by another substantial cohort from later people.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the excavated-soil branch of ث ل ل is distant from the conventional collective noun. It remains anchored through that focus root, the return-to-outcome branch of ء و ل, and nearby new creation; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy of reconstitution, never as a direct translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ثُلَّةٌ as gathered or returned material from ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

activation_trace.role: Soil brought out from a well or grave supplies the material image of a body recovered from what held it.
Return to an outcome supplies re-emergence rather than mere chronological priority.
New creation converts the recovered-material image into a contained reassembly mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A numerical crowd inherited from the past.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, a body of earlier people imaged as brought out and constituted anew.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain reading from wool or cord, ordered joining, extension, and succession, so it cannot replace the normal sense of ثلة. It remains focus-anchored in the noun's material branch and the split ء و ل mapping; downstream prose should qualify it as a social-fabric image.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ثُلَّةٌ as wool or cord joined to the successive force latent in أَوَّلِينَ

activation_trace.role: Wool, cord, or woven material supplies interlacing as the cohort's exploratory social image.
Uninterrupted succession supplies continuity between members or generations.
Ordered joining gives the strands coordinated structure.
Connected length lets the ordered fabric extend through time.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, an interwoven leading band whose members form a continuous social fabric.

strongest_changes: The repeated companions-of-the-right frame turns a free crowd into an affiliated contingent.
Recreation and equal age separate earlier provenance from present seniority.
The matching ثلة in 56:40 makes 56:39 one side of a substantial earlier/later pair.
summary.what_was_special: The split ء و ل inventory kept temporal beginning and uninterrupted succession live together; the local transformation sequence and mirrored later cohort then made firstness relational rather than a single chronological label.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether recreated firstness should color الأولين or remain confined to the preceding description.
Whether the mirrored ثلة phrases imply comparable magnitude or only parallel category.
The material continuity and excavation readings are analogical activations, not lexical replacements.
